cpmplus.gestparts.wiz.game.desc: What the button is called in game. Animations with the same name in game become ONE button and play together.
cpmplus.gestparts.wiz.part.desc: A label that tells the parts of one button apart in Blockbench, e.g. 'body', 'legs'. It must not end in a number (Blockbench renumbers names that end in a number).
cpmplus.gestparts.wiz.hint.label: Tip
cpmplus.gestparts.wiz.hint: Animations with the same Name in game become ONE button and play together. Each part can move other body parts, with its own additive and priority.
cpmplus.gestparts.badge.tip: Same name before the # = ONE button in game, they play together
cpmplus.gestparts.err.hashGame: The name in game can't have '#': the # separates the part.
cpmplus.gestparts.err.digit: The part can't end in a number: Blockbench renumbers names that end in a number. Put a letter at the end, e.g. 'part_a' instead of 'part1'.
cpmplus.gestparts.err.taken: There already is an animation called '%s'. Pick another part.
cpmplus.gestparts.menu.join.desc: Several animations become ONE button in game (the names become 'Name#part'). Nothing is deleted.
cpmplus.gestparts.menu.split.desc: This animation gets its own button in game.
cpmplus.gestparts.join.title: Join into the same gesture
cpmplus.gestparts.join.hint: The checked animations become parts of ONE button in game and play together. Nothing is deleted: only the names change to 'Name#part'. Only animations of the same type can be joined.
cpmplus.gestparts.join.needTwo: Check at least 2 animations of the type gesture, layer or value layer.
cpmplus.gestparts.join.notGrouped: '%s' is not a gesture, layer or value layer: only those can be parts of one button.
cpmplus.gestparts.join.typesDiffer: The checked animations have different types. Only animations of the same type can be one button.
cpmplus.gestparts.join.otherType: The name in game '%s' is already used by '%s', which has another type. Pick another name.
cpmplus.gestparts.join.staged: '%s' has a start / end animation '%s' that would lose its link. Rename or remove it first.
cpmplus.gestparts.join.nothing: Nothing to change: they already are parts of '%s'.
cpmplus.gestparts.split.title: Split from this gesture
cpmplus.gestparts.split.hint: '%s' gets its own button in game. Type a new name in game that no other animation uses.
cpmplus.gestparts.split.notPart: Only a gesture, layer or value layer can be split from a button.
cpmplus.gestparts.split.taken: '%s' is already used by another animation. Pick another name.
cpmplus.gestparts.warn.types: The same name in game '%s' is used by different types (%s). In game they would fight over ONE button.
cpmplus.gestparts.warn.types.ifIgnored: In game the button does the wrong thing, or the export fails.
cpmplus.gestparts.warn.button: The parts of '%s' have different button settings (%s). In game it is ONE button, so only one value counts.
cpmplus.gestparts.warn.button.ifIgnored: In game the button may not do what the Blockbench preview shows.
cpmplus.gestparts.fix.same: Use the same value in all
cpmplus.gestparts.fix.same.undo: Same button settings in every part
cpmplus.gestparts.fix.same.done: the parts of '%s' now use the settings of '%s'
cpmplus.gestparts.warn.maybe: %s look like copies renamed by Blockbench (same name, another number at the end). If they were parts of the same gesture, join them.
cpmplus.gestparts.importNote: %s animations had the same name and became parts of one button: %s. Same button in game; Blockbench will not renumber them any more.
